title: Elementary coefficient cases for the normalized direct-image mate
statement: Let ell be prime, k a field of positive characteristic different from ell, and f : X → Y a morphism of separated finite-type k-schemes. For each of the six primitive constructors finite, integers, fields, localization, algebraicClosure and integralFinite of ListedCoefficientMap, retain exactly its endpoint rings, actual bundled map a and its normalization hypothesis. Then the specified counit mate scalarDirectImageMate a f is invertible at each bounded constant-model constructible input of finite Tor amplitude over its source coefficient. For the identity of the finite-subextension-valued algebraic-closure coefficient the same mate is invertible at every ambient derived input. This statement contains neither composite coefficient maps nor preservation claims nor geometric coherence equations.

proof.text: Cancellation of the structure morphisms over k gives finite type and separatedness of f; hence it is qcqs. In the finite-ring case transport the bounded constructible finite-Tor input and the normalized scalar mate to fixed module sheaves via the finite-discrete coefficient equivalences. Apply finiteRingRelativeScalarComparison with p=ringChar k and positive annihilator exponents (enlarge any exponent zero). Its relative torsion bound works over arbitrary standing k, and its conclusion identifies this mate, including nonflat maps and zero coefficient rings. Reflect invertibility through the target equivalence.

For the integral and field extension constructors cartesianCoefficients gives finite-free scalar modules. Apply finiteFreeDirectImageCoherence through the canonical section-module presentation. Its counit-mate normalization and thetaNormalization identify the comparison with scalarDirectImageMate. For the integral-to-finite constructor use the actual continuous map witnessing IsIntegralFiniteScalarMap and integralFiniteScalarPerfectModel. Its augmentation identifies restricted scalar extension with tensor by the pulled-back two-term finite-free complex; its normalized projection is invertible, hence so is this mate by conservative scalar restriction.

source.place: Finite free and finitely presented coefficient extensions

proof.text: The constructibility hypothesis includes boundedness and therefore bounded-below membership. Use localizedDirectImageComparison_isIso for O_E to E and isIso_derivedPushHom_padicAlgCl_of_boundedBelow for E to the finite-subextension-valued algebraic closure. The underlying bundled coefficient maps equal the prescribed inclusions by the constructor normalizations. The canonical derived functor comparisons and equality of their adjuncts (extension of the same counit following theta inverse) identify the published comparison with scalarDirectImageMate. Transport invertibility along these isomorphisms.

source.place: O_E to E and E to Qlbar

proof.text: For the identity of the algebraic-closure coefficient, conjugate the identity-on-underlying-sheaves restriction square by the scalar unit isomorphisms. Its pullback mate is the scalar unit square. The two geometric triangle identities give the identity direct-image map after these unit identifications, proving invertibility for every ambient input.

theorem scalarDirectImageElementaryCases
    (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime] (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ell)]
    {X Y : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [QuasiCompact X.hom] [IsSeparated X.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] [QuasiCompact Y.hom] [IsSeparated Y.hom]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (∀ (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
      (hA : ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ x : A, (ell ^ n) • x = 0)
      (hB : ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ x : B, (ell ^ n) • x = 0)
      (φ : A →+* B)
      (a : (⟨cartesianFinitePointRing A⟩ : ScalarSixRing.{u}) ⟶
        ⟨cartesianFinitePointRing B⟩)
      (ha : ∀ (P : Profinite.{u}) (s : (cartesianFinitePointRing A).obj.obj (op P)) (x : P),
        ((a.hom.hom.hom.app (op P)) s).down x = φ (s.down x)),
      ∀ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules
          (cartesianFinitePointRing A) X.left),
      (constantModelBoundedConstructible (cartesianFinitePointRing A) X.left K ∧
        DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ K) →
      IsIso ((scalarDirectImageMate a f.left).app K)) ∧
    (∀ (E F : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ell) (h : E ≤ F)
      (a : (⟨Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ell E.1⟩ : ScalarSixRing.{u}) ⟶
        ⟨Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ell F.1⟩)
      (ha : a.hom.hom = finiteCoefficientIntegersPointMap ell h),
      ∀ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules
          (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ell E.1) X.left),
      (constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ell E.1) X.left K ∧
        DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ K) →
      IsIso ((scalarDirectImageMate a f.left).app K)) ∧
    (∀ (E F : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ell) (h : E ≤ F)
      (a : (⟨Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E.1⟩ : ScalarSixRing.{u}) ⟶
        ⟨Profinite.continuousMapRingObj F.1⟩)
      (ha : a.hom.hom = Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjMap ell h),
      ∀ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules
          (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E.1) X.left),
      (constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E.1) X.left K ∧
        DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ K) →
      IsIso ((scalarDirectImageMate a f.left).app K)) ∧
    (∀ (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ell)
      (a : (⟨Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ell E.1⟩ : ScalarSixRing.{u}) ⟶
        ⟨Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E.1⟩)
      (ha : a.hom.hom = (sheafCompose (coherentTopology Profinite.{u})
        (forget₂ RingCat.{u + 1} Ab.{u + 1})).map
          (Profinite.padicIntegersCondensedRingToPadicSubfieldCondensedRing ell E.1)),
      ∀ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules
          (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ell E.1) X.left),
      (constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ell E.1) X.left K ∧
        DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ K) →
      IsIso ((scalarDirectImageMate a f.left).app K)) ∧
    (∀ (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ell)
      (a : (⟨Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E.1⟩ : ScalarSixRing.{u}) ⟶
        ⟨Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ell⟩)
      (ha : a.hom.hom = Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl ell E),
      ∀ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules
          (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E.1) X.left),
      (constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E.1) X.left K ∧
        DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ K) →
      IsIso ((scalarDirectImageMate a f.left).app K)) ∧
    (∀ (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ell)
      (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
      (hA : ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ x : A, (ell ^ n) • x = 0)
      (a : (⟨Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ell E.1⟩ : ScalarSixRing.{u}) ⟶
        ⟨cartesianFinitePointRing A⟩)
      (ha : IsIntegralFiniteScalarMap ell E A a),
      ∀ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules
          (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ell E.1) X.left),
      (constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ell E.1) X.left K ∧
        DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ K) →
      IsIso ((scalarDirectImageMate a f.left).app K)) ∧
    (∀ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules
        (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ell) X.left),
      IsIso ((scalarDirectImageMate
        (𝟙 (⟨Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ell⟩ : ScalarSixRing.{u})) f.left).app K))
